So how do we reduce it?
So this is the second observation.

Since we already processed those objects using CNN, the cheap CNN, now we can extract the features that we get from the process and then we can leverage the observation that the images with similar features, they are visually similar.
This is a well established study so that we can now cluster those features based on the distance and so that we can make the objects, the same objects into the same cluster.
For example, here we see that the trucks or the person, maybe a little bit different angle, but they will be clustered together.
And then at query time, we only need to check once per cluster instead of all the objects.
So how do we integrate clustering into our architecture?
Here, instead of straight -generated type -k indexing from cheap CNN, we first extract the features from the cheap CNNs and then we cluster the objects to generate the clusters.
And then we save the type -k results from the cluster centroid so now the type -k index becomes base for cluster, not for objects.
Then at query time, we only need to check the centroid objects and apply the results to the whole cluster.
So we only need to run the query time work once per cluster and reduce the redundancy.
Finally, we also enable trade -off between interest cost and query latency.
So in focus, we have several parameters that we can select.

We can use that to enable flexible trade -off between interest cost versus query latency, such as which cheap CNN we use and what's the type -k results that we are selecting and what's the threshold for clustering.
To do that, we plotted different configurations in this figure where the excess is interest cost and the y -axis is query latency.

And here we have different set of configurations and then we can select different options such as the option that balances these two metrics or for the applications that requires low latency and they are query a lot, then we can run select the option that pay a little bit more cost than interest time to achieve lower query latency or for applications such as home cameras that we don't know when we are going to query, we can optimize for interest cost with higher latency.
